messages:
maya: folks, quick sync on the provisioning/confirmation modal for autoscale edits. uploaded a new frame in figma: https://www.figma.com/file/ABC/provisioning-modal liam: looks cleaner. first pass: cost line needs clearer units and the CTA copy feels ambiguous. sara: copy suggestion: header 'Confirm autoscale changes' and primary CTA 'Apply changes' with secondary 'Provision now' as tooltip or helper text. ethan: accessibility checklist: focus should move into modal and land on the first actionable element, aria-live for cost + SLO updates, and ensure error messages are announced. olivia: product ask: show a compact summary row at the top with 3 cards: delta cost, projected 99p latency, selected GPU pool. lets users scan fast. maya: added summary row in figma. question on burst: should burst toggle be interactive when min == max? liam: prefer to disable burst toggle when min==max and show a clear tooltip explaining why, otherwise users get confusing behavior. sara: tooltip copy: 'Burst requires baseline min to be lower than max. Increase max to enable short spikes.' keeps it actionable. ben: GPU pool selector: propose inline pool badges: name, GPUs free, latency tier (low/med/high). clicking a badge selects it. also mark default pool used for burst. kelsey: mobile constraints: badges need to collapse to abbreviated chips (icon + short text) so modal doesn't overflow. ethan: implementation notes: debounce estimate API on slider changes (250ms), show skeleton in the cost and SLO cards while computing, cancel inflight requests on new input. liam: visuals: when estimates change, animate numbers gently; avoid sudden jumps that might feel like flicker. also ensure dark theme colors for primary CTA don't clash with danger. sara: microcopy: change 'estimated cost impact' -> 'estimated monthly cost change (approx.)' and add an info link 'assumptions' that opens a lightweight panel. ben: assumptions panel should list tokens/hr, avg seq length, region pricing and quantization profile. make them read-only but link to a docs page. maya: UX decision: show SLO delta as relative (e.g., 99p latency: 120ms → 95ms) with a small 'estimate' badge. do not present as guarantee. olivia: we should surface guardrails inline: if the change would violate customer SLOs, show a red warning and require an extra confirmation step. kelsey: also add keyboard focus target sizes to controls (min 44px) and ensure badges have aria-labels when icon-only. ethan: sample aria snippet in comments:
\n
Estimated monthly cost: $14.20
\n
liam: QA note: test cases for when min==max, when burst enabled + low capacity, and when pool has insufficient GPUs. fallback should pick compatible pool and show a note. sara: copy tweak for disabled burst tooltip: 'Burst is disabled because min equals max. To enable burst, increase max capacity.' reads clearer. ben: backend constraint: if user chooses a pool without burst capability, disable burst and add a hover explanation 'Selected pool does not support burst.' maya: added action items to figma comments: - update copy (sara) - add summary row + expand/collapse details (liam) - badges for pools + mobile chips (ben + kelsey) - debounce + skeleton (ethan) - accessibility audit (ethan + kelsey) deploy-bot: uploaded image -> provision-modal-v3.png olivia: i'll turn the top-row metrics into telemetry checks for the spec: delta cost within 10%, SLO delta computed in <200ms, skeleton appears during compute. maya: thanks. aim to have final sign-off next Weds. ping me in thread when prototypes go to staging. :thumbsup:
